note: Two numbers only. Asch's conformity result is the classic one and is quoted at the figures Asch himself reported; everything else in this act is an idea, not a measurement, and is presented as one.
source: Solomon Asch, "Effects of group pressure upon the modification and distortion of judgments" (1951) and "Studies of independence and conformity" (Psychological Monographs, 1956): about three quarters of participants went along with the obviously wrong majority at least once, and roughly a third of all critical responses followed the majority. The beauty contest is John Maynard Keynes, The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money (1936), chapter 12. Freud, The Interpretation of Dreams (1899).
